signature.name: VTask.ContinuousWithinAt
signature.type: {X : Type u_1} -> {Y : Type u_2} -> [TopologicalSpace X] -> [TopologicalSpace Y] -> (f : X → Y) -> (s : Set X) -> (x : X) -> Prop

conventions.point: x is not a limit point of s
conventions.statement: When x is isolated from s (the within-neighbourhood filter 𝓝[s] x contains no points of s other than possibly x itself), VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f s x holds for every f.
conventions.note: Vacuous tendsto: the filter 𝓝[s] x is trivial or supported only at x, so the convergence condition imposes no real constraint.

conventions.statement: VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f ∅ x is true for every f : X → Y and every x : X.
conventions.note: The within-filter 𝓝[∅] x equals ⊥, and tendsto from ⊥ to any filter holds trivially.

facts.statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ), VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f Set.univ x ↔ ContinuousAt f x

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (s : Set X) (x : X), Continuous f → VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f s x

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (s t : Set X) (x : X), VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f t x → s ⊆ t → VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f s x

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {X Y Z : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace Z] (g : Y → Z) (f : X → Y) (s : Set X) (x : X), VTask.ContinuousWithinAt g (Set.range f) (f x) → VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f s x → VTask.ContinuousWithinAt (g ∘ f) s x

facts.statement: ∀ {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (s : Set X) (x : X), VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f s x ↔ VTask.ContinuousWithinAt f (insert x s) x
